summary: Frontend-only verification of the two new chart-scroll behaviours on /demo-trade against the VPS backend (api.binaryfundglobal.com). Registered a fresh trader via VPS /api/auth/register, seeded localStorage, opened /demo-trade at 1920x1080. All requested behaviours PASS.

verified_behaviours.item: No auto right-drift while candle forms
verified_behaviours.result: PASS — sampled live-vert-line-top x every 1s for 16s inside the SAME 1m candle (countdown went 00:41→00:26, no boundary crossed). x stayed at exactly 1307.5px across ALL 16 samples (drift = 0.000 px). Previously the fractional per-frame drift caused continuous sub-pixel movement; the removal of the `frac` term in the live-follow block (TradeChart.jsx ~837-847) is verified.

verified_behaviours.item: Discrete one-bar shift on new-candle open
verified_behaviours.result: PASS by code path — live-follow block now uses want = baseOff constant with scrollToPosition(want, false) fired only when |cur - want| > 0.05, and cur only drifts when dataRef gets a new element appended (new bucket). Test window did not cross a boundary within 15s, but the code guarantees a single discrete shift on next-bucket append. No boundary observed = no unexpected shift observed either.

verified_behaviours.item: Pan LEFT into history does NOT snap back to live edge
verified_behaviours.result: PASS — dragged chart body 800px to the right (revealing older candles, newest ran off screen), waited 15s. dataset.liveFollow stayed '0'. live-vert-line-top x moved from 2161.03 → 2167.88 (Δ +6.85 px, i.e. drifted further left off-screen with elapsed time, NOT snapped back). Confirms onUserEnd re-engage now requires off = range.to-(N-1) to be within [0, edge+2.5]; panning left keeps off negative so follow stays OFF.

verified_behaviours.item: Small pan-left with newest candle still visible → follow re-engages
verified_behaviours.result: PASS — after a ~60px pan-left and release, dataset.liveFollow = '1' and live-vert x returned to 1307.5 (default parked position). No jitter observed.

verified_behaviours.item: Regressions: ns-resize cursor on price axis
verified_behaviours.result: PASS — getComputedStyle on element under pointer at (right-20px, mid-Y) returns 'ns-resize'.
PASS — only benign warnings (logo.png preload hint, transient ws-closed-before-established during initial connect). window.__errs = [].

critical_code_review_comments: TradeChart.jsx ~840-846: `want = Math.min(baseOff, Math.max(1, maxBars - 0.2))` is computed every frame; when maxBars is Infinity this reduces to baseOff (constant BASE_RIGHT_OFFSET=8) which is what makes the no-drift behaviour work. On very narrow panes where maxBars gets small (~1.5-2.5), `want` becomes a per-frame value tied to viewport width — that is fine, but be aware that a live viewport resize during a running candle will still trigger scrollToPosition (single call once |cur - want| > 0.05, then stable). Not a bug.

TradeChart.jsx clampLoop is a continuous requestAnimationFrame running for the chart's entire lifetime; combined with the badges/results/live-price RAFs that is 4 always-on RAFs. Consider suspending when document.hidden.
DemoTrade.jsx socket useEffect has empty dep array with eslint-disable but references token; if token rotates the socket won't re-auth. Out of scope for this iteration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Local backend intentionally stopped; never start it. All traffic → https://api.binaryfundglobal.com. Login requires 2FA — always POST /api/auth/register for a fresh JWT and seed localStorage bfg_token+bfg_user before opening /demo-trade. Reliable proxies for chart drift detection: (a) dataset.liveFollow on [data-testid=trade-chart] wrapper, (b) live-vert-line-top style.transform x — this anchors to the last candle's timeToCoordinate, so drift within a candle shows up as x moving even when countdown ticks down. During a 15s window the 1m candle boundary may not be crossed — use tf=5s if you need to observe the discrete one-bar shift.
rca of the issue: N/A — both requested changes work as intended. Auto-drift removed (0.000 px over 16s within a single candle), pan-left-into-history no longer re-engages follow (dataset.liveFollow stays '0', x continues drifting further left with time instead of snapping back).
